Step-by-Step Guide

Tap any step timer to launch Cook Mode right there

restaurant_menu
1

Set Up Heavy Saucepan & Ingredients

Place a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-low heat and have a heatproof silicone whisk ready. Measure out 2 cups whole milk & heavy cream and 3 yolks egg yolks (or cornstarch thickener) and 1/3 cup granulated sugar and 1/2 cup fresh ripe strawberries & mixed berries in advance—stovetop desserts move fast once they start bubbling.

2

Whisk Custard Silky Over Low Heat

Warm 2 cups whole milk & heavy cream and 1/3 cup granulated sugar, whisk into 3 yolks egg yolks (or cornstarch thickener), and cook gently stirring until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Keep heat medium-low and stir continuously so the custard stays satin-smooth.

3

Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly

Fold 1/3 cup granulated sugar and 1/2 cup fresh ripe strawberries & mixed berries into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

4

Chill 2 Hours & Add Topping

Pour into dessert glasses, chill 2 hours, and crown with 1/2 cup fresh ripe strawberries & mixed berries and whipped cream. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.

lightbulb
Creator Secret

Press plastic wrap directly onto the warm custard surface while chilling to prevent a skin from forming.

Nutrition, Storage & Healthy Prep Notes

CALORIES285 kcal
SERVINGS4
SUGAR MODEClassic

Make-Ahead & Storage: Keep rødgrød in an airtight glass container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days (or freeze individual portions up to 1 month). Pair with unsweetened Greek yogurt, fresh berries, or espresso for a balanced treat.

Keto & Low-Sugar Tip: Toggle Healthy Swap above to substitute refined sugar with monk fruit or coconut sugar and white flour with oat or almond flour.
